exposure: Duration of second stage of labor
cohort: 15,992 women with singleton pregnancy at term who delivered vaginally in cephalic presentation at a University Teaching Hospital in Italy between 2009 and 2019.
finding: Nulliparous women delivering by vacuum delivery without epidural anesthesia had the highest risk of obstetric anal sphincter injuries.
mod_finding: Nulliparous women delivering by vacuum delivery had a nearly 2-fold increased odds of severe perineal lacerations compared to those with spontaneous vaginal delivery or at least one previous delivery.
